confidence_notes: Nara food estimates use Numbeo data last updated 19 June 2026, based on 15 contributors in the prior 18 months. Cocktail and wine-glass prices are inferred from the local draft-beer level at roughly 2.4× and 1.3×, respectively. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from the supplied city comparisons.
comparable_city_reasoning: Nara's year-typical lodging is estimated below Kyoto and Nagoya, near or slightly below Aomori, and above Tottori, allowing for Nara's tourism demand. Hostel prices are kept near the supplied Kyoto benchmarks.
